title: Observability: KEY_IMPORT and KEY_GENERATE lookup/init failures emit no log
description: ioctl_key_import (crypto2dev_fd.c:1495-1522) and ioctl_key_generate (crypto2dev_fd.c:1572-1598) silently return errors for three failure cases with no log: (1) crypto2dev_lookup_algo returns NULL (no provider found for algo) — returns -ENOENT with no message; (2) ops->key_import or ops->key_generate is NULL (algo found but does not support key ops) — returns -EOPNOTSUPP with no message; (3) ops->key_import/key_generate returns an error — only emits a WARN if key_ctx is non-NULL (the leak case), not a normal pr_err for the common path. Compare ioctl_init which emits distinct pr_info messages for all three analogous failures. A support engineer debugging a failed KEY_IMPORT or KEY_GENERATE gets only an errno from the ioctl return with nothing in the ring buffer identifying the algo, provider, or error code.
